ValidationRule.description: The Lost Reason fields must be populated if the Contract has been terminated, if the contract is not terminated then the record cannot be saved with the fields populated.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( NOT(ISCHANGED(OwnerId)), OR( AND ( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Terminated"), OR( ISPICKVAL(Lost_Reason__c, ""), ISBLANK(Lost_Reason_Comments__c) ) ), AND ( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, "Terminated")), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Lost_Reason__c, "")), NOT(ISBLANK(Lost_Reason_Comments__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Lost_to_Competitor__c)) ) ) ), $User.Email <> "dataloader@oceantg.com" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Lost Reason fields cannot be empty if Contract is Terminated or cannot be populated if Contract is not Terminated
